summary: Verified the Economic Groups PDF logo bug fix. GET /api/grupos-economicos/{id}/export-pdf returned 200 application/pdf for 6 groups (including multi-page ones: Grupo David and Farmacias San Ignacio Grupo C&T, 2 pages each). PyMuPDF found exactly 1 image on every page, with bbox (53.5,15.6)-(128.6,45.6), which is the top-left corner (75x30pt). The old stretched body logo is gone. The text has 'Grupo Económico: <name>' and the headers Nombre de Fantasía / RIF / Nombre Jurídico. Unknown group returns 404. UI: on /grupos-economicos, clicking the PDF button group-pdf-grp_d881121e1f7c (ALKOSTO) downloaded Grupo_ALKOSTO.pdf (113KB) with no error toast. I checked that file with fitz (1 image, top-left) and rendered page 1 to look at it: only the small logo in the top-left header band.
critical_code_review_comments: economic_groups.py: header_row is now a 1-cell Table wrapping only two Paragraphs. It is harmless but could be simplified to add the Paragraphs directly to the story (optional).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login via POST /api/auth/login (rgonzalez@megasoft.com.ve / MegaSoft2026*) returns session_token; in Playwright set localStorage 'session_token'. Navigate to /dashboard first and wait, then /grupos-economicos (going straight there right after setting the token redirected to the dashboard). PDF buttons: data-testid group-pdf-{group_id}. fitz is available only in the backend python, not in the playwright runtime.
